metrics.split: Seed-42 stratified 80/20 split after normalized exact-text deduplication. TF-IDF fitted on training only. Near-duplicates and employer overlap may remain; not a temporal or India-specific evaluation.

dataset: EMSCAD: 17,880 real job ads labeled legitimate/fraudulent, collected 2012-2014. Public University of the Aegean corpus via GitHub mirror. Class-weighted model score is not calibrated fraud probability.
